name: BACH_0349
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with all 12 regions scoring invasive and tumor at all four margins [F12].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% [F1] | Single dominant class; ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at alpha 10% | 90% dataset coverage; mean 1.31 |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 26th percentile OOD [F6] | Typical input; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (89%–93% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous reference neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive score (+1.62); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 7, 9) · context · High score (1.62, contribution -1.43); 8/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable concept (+0.76 contribution); 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.66) adds +0.73; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Neoplastic density and nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 6) · context · 3464 cells/mm² (97th percentile) [F8]; size variation 100th percentile [F10] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Classifier-faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dense TILs (regions 4, 7, 9) obscure duct borders, mimicking invasion over InSitu (contrast case BACH_0165, 83% similarity).
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts inflate margin calls or tumor counts despite small nuclear size (35.5 µm², 0th percentile) [F9].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: Verify true stromal invasion versus InSitu where validated invasion scores peak.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 3, 6**: Count mitoses manually (unreliable 0/20 concept) and confirm 69% tumor cell fraction [F7].
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Inspect superior/inferior (860 µm) and medial/lateral (645 µm) margins for tumor involvement.
